ball_interpolation_max_s.rationale: Bound interpolation to gaps short enough to retain local ball context.

candidate_confirmation_s.rationale: Require persistent evidence before a direct possession change.

restart_confirmation_s.rationale: Allow a clear restart to become live faster than an open-play switch.

restart_evidence_confirmation_s.rationale: Shorten D-to-team confirmation only while independent restart evidence is active.

dead_ball_confirmation_s.rationale: Require sustained explicit stoppage evidence before entering D.

ball_rest_min_s.rationale: Use sustained stationary ball evidence as a weak D trigger.

ball_rest_speed_mps.rationale: Tolerance for tracking noise around a stationary ball.

near_player_vote_k.rationale: A small neighbourhood reduces reliance on one noisy slot.

restart_zone_radius_m.rationale: Optional proximity feature around generic restart anchors.

reachability_extra_speed_mps.rationale: Optimistic acceleration allowance for an optional reachability feature.

cleanup_short_flicker_max_s.rationale: Remove only a very short interruption bracketed by the same state.

cleanup_minimum_segment_s.rationale: Optional minimum duration; disabled until external validation.

cleanup_isolated_dead_ball_max_s.rationale: Optional isolated-D cleanup; disabled by default.

use_visible_team_vote.rationale: Require nearest-team and small-neighbourhood evidence not to conflict.

use_ball_rest_dead_ball.rationale: Enable sustained ball rest as explicit, non-missing-only dead-ball evidence.

enable_restart_zone.rationale: Keep restart-zone proximity as a disabled experimental feature.

enable_reachability.rationale: Keep optimistic reachability out of the default score.

enable_smart_tagging.rationale: Smart Tagging remains optional until its weak-prior mapping is reviewed.

enable_short_flicker_cleanup.rationale: Absorb only same-neighbour short flicker after state inference.

enable_minimum_segment_cleanup.rationale: Do not merge possible short real possessions without external evidence.

enable_isolated_dead_ball_cleanup.rationale: Do not erase potential dead-ball evidence unless validated.

enable_out_of_play_dead_ball.rationale: Candidate A: ball beyond the touchline or goal line is a dead-ball signal.

out_of_play_margin_m.rationale: Ball radius plus tracking error beyond the line.

use_restart_zone_dead_ball.rationale: Candidate A: restart-zone proximity strengthens a resting ball.

use_team_motion_dead_ball.rationale: Candidate A: low team motion strengthens a resting ball; never used alone.

team_motion_dead_mps.rationale: A stoppage sits near walking pace; jogging is about 2 m/s.

team_motion_scale_mps.rationale: Soft threshold scale for the team-motion gate.
